preObservationAmendment: Before any application observations: use two memory comparison pairs per provider so two A/A calibration pairs and complete cleanup fit the one-hour cap; measure allocations for protected increments separately from reconnect churn. Record protocol-ready reconnect timing separately from the polled interactive verification.
completedWorkAmendment: Two fixture warmups failed before any numeric sample: submitting the next action before SET_EVENT_COUNTER acknowledgment causes intentional event deduplication. The collector must await that acknowledgment and browser handling before the next action. Per-event latency remains click-to-DOM acknowledgment; achieved throughput includes the full protocol acknowledgment. Both failed attempts are retained; a third failure on this issue stops collection.
scope: Identical v4 public example sources against fixed v4 release and v5 candidate JARs. Only a common configurable-origin fixture patch and candidate ownership-enum source migration are permitted. Compare memory and JDBC exclusive mode. Shared multi-node behavior has no supported equivalent v4 topology and is not represented as a paired no-regression comparison.

execution.order: A/A calibration first, then alternating AB/BA paired comparison

analysis.estimator: Mean paired relative change, oriented so positive is worse; absolute differences when a baseline is zero. Quantiles remain per process, never pooled.
analysis.interval: Bonferroni-adjusted paired percentile bootstrap across 44 comparison/calibration intervals, tail=0.05/(4*22); small pair counts are diagnostic, not a full acceptance proof.
analysis.pass: All measured bounds at or below zero with usable A/A calibration. Missing, unsupported, incomplete or ambiguous results remain inconclusive. No positive slowdown allowance is introduced.
analysis.fullReleaseAcceptance: Not established by this reduced diagnostic matrix or unsupported measurements. Do not modify or freeze the historical 94-cell manifest.
